author: Zitkala-Sa (Gertrude Bonnin)
title: American Indian Stories
edition: Washington: Hayworth Publishing House, 1921 (first edition; title page in Internet Archive americanindianst1921zitk), as transcribed in Project Gutenberg 10376. Prose line wrapping and surrounding whitespace normalized; paragraph divisions, spelling, punctuation and underscore emphasis notation retained. Publisher and digitizer matter excluded. One transcription error corrected to the 1921 print: “My fingers grey icy cold” (page 74; the print’s own lower-case “grey,” itself a misprint for “grew,” is kept).

rights.basis: This original English text was published in 1921, more than 95 years before 2026; Project Gutenberg explicitly identifies its transcription as public domain in the USA. The dated source edition, rather than the electronic release date, supplies the publication year.

acquisition.method: Project Gutenberg 10376 plain text (UTF-8) from the PG mirror aleph.pglaf.org. Removed the PG header and footer, the title-page author description and the contents list; kept the title, the epigraph and all ten pieces in printed order. Lines of each paragraph joined with single spaces. The ten piece titles are level-2 headings; numbered section labels and section titles stay paragraphs, except the unpunctuated IRON ROUTINE and the sub-heads of America's Indian Problem, which are level-3 headings. The transcription's footnote stays where it stands. The one declared emendation (Grey to the printed grey) is applied before conversion.
